title: Design: a below-cost price in the simulator
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, one range from $0.00 with Default on Margin % 40, tier A on % Off 95.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Point at the warning icon beside tier A's simulator price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's simulator price shows a small orange warning triangle right after it.
  • Its profit line starts with a minus sign.
  • The minus profit line is red, while the other profit lines are gray, as in picture 5.2.
  • The same orange triangle shows beside tier A's 95% off values in the grid above.

Step 3:

  • A dark tooltip reads "Below cost."
